articles.title: Ether outruns bitcoin as ETF money returns, almost all of from BlackRock's fund
articles.snippet: This is not a broad rally as bitcoin is up 4% over the same stretch, and solana, TRON and hyperliquid are all lower.

articles.title: Bitcoin Giant Strategy Isn't Panicking—Unless BTC Crashes to $10K: CEO
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury giant will issue fresh preferred stock and resume buying once its Stretch shares climb back to par, CEO Phong Le said.
